title: The Conveni 2: Zenkoku Chain Tenkai da!
native_title: ザ・コンビニ２ ～全国チェーン展開だ！～
overview: In The Conveni 2, you run convenience stores as you try to expand your chain nationwide. As the owner, try to boost sales and increase your number of stores to achieve the goals on each map. The game's graphics have been completely retooled and more maps have been added! A high-speed mode has also been added! Even playability has been improved! This is a complete convenience simulation in which you can send spies to rival stores to collect information and even buy out your competitors! Go for it! Expand till you are a nationwide chain!
